items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: that's where I met and saw Earl Papa Hines

ctx.x: Now, uh, so you played on the boats for how long? Uh, I played that season, uh, 1933. Uh-huh.

And, uh, we left, uh, St. Paul, Minnesota, where I was up in St. Paul, Minnesota. We left New Orleans and went right up the river. Every town and every city, uh, on the Mississippi River we played. Until we got to St. Paul, Minnesota, that was about in, uh, July. Let's see, June, July, about the middle of July. And then, uh, uh, that was the end of the season, began to get cold up in St. Paul.
